label: end-of-episode clock: last ~10 trials, D2 and unrewarded D1
explanation: Fires only near the end of the 100-trial episode: zero activity before trial 80, ~1% of mass in trials 80-89, 99% in trials 90-99; equivalently it fires almost exclusively when the value head is low (value < 5.22 holds 99.7% of mass), as value falls with fewer trials remaining. Within that window it fires on D2 (54% of mass, stronger after reaching S1, especially rare a2->S1) and on D1 after an unrewarded trial (in_rew=1 rate 0.4x); it is largely silent at GO (6% of mass) and when a reward is shown. Magnitude ramps up over the final trials (ep_trial>=96 covers 77% of the top quartile vs 39% of the bottom). Observed-only predicate (ep_trial is the agent elapsed time). Simpler (ep_trial >= 90) & (phase != GO) gives dev F1 0.54 / mass recall 0.93; recorded predicate dev F1 0.66 / mass 0.86. Precision limited because within late trials it fires on only a subset of D1/D2 steps and the onset trial varies by episode.
